Ph.D. Program
The Cornell Civil and Environmental Engineering Ph.D. program is interdisciplinary by design, addressing complex challenges at the intersection of infrastructure, sustainability, and public service. Our research advances the public good through pioneering technological and scientific innovations that shape the future of built and natural environments.
Apply Now
Ph.D. Program
Admission Requirements
Degree Requirements
Ph.D. Handbook
Contact Us
Our Ph.D. program is designed for individuals who want to delve deeply into a specialized area of study, mastering core concepts while contributing original research that drives meaningful progress in the field.
Our program spans groundbreaking research across multiple scales—from molecular to global systems—addressing critical challenges in structural resilience, environmental protection, water resource management, transportation networks, and complex systems engineering. Through innovative computational modeling, advanced experimental methods, and sustainable design approaches, our scholars develop solutions to society’s most pressing infrastructure and environmental challenges.
Our program fosters an interdisciplinary environment, where collaboration and curiosity fuel groundbreaking discoveries. With access to world-class faculty, cutting-edge research facilities, and a vibrant academic community, students will be well-equipped to make a lasting impact—both in academia and in industry.
The Ph.D. Program Experience
We design sustainable infrastructure, shape vibrant urban spaces, and build resilient communities—solving environmental challenges with purpose and innovation.
